title: Biodiversity Levels & Global Species Estimates
topic: Edward Wilson, Genetic/Species/Ecological Levels, Robert May's 7M Estimate, & Taxonomic Proportions
quickSummary: Biodiversity (Edward Wilson): Totality of genes, species, and ecosystems across the biosphere. 3 hierarchical levels: (1) Genetic Diversity (within a species: Rauvolfia vomitoria Reserpine potency variations, >50k rice strains); (2) Species Diversity (variety within a region: Western Ghats amphibians > Eastern Ghats); (3) Ecological Diversity (biome variety: India > Norway). Global estimates: 1.7-1.8 million described species; Robert May global estimate = 7 million. Taxonomic proportions: Animals >70% (Insects >70% of animals), Plants <22%, and Fungi species on Earth > Fishes + Amphibians + Reptiles + Mammals combined! India: 2.4% global land area, 8.1% global species diversity (12 Mega-Diversity nations).

conceptBreakdown.content:
### 1.1 The Concept of Biodiversity
- The term **Biodiversity** was popularized by sociobiologist **Edward Wilson** to describe the combined diversity and heterogeneity present across all levels of biological organization.

### 1.2 Three Hierarchical Levels of Biodiversity
1. **Genetic Diversity**:
   - Diversity of genes, alleles, and chromosomal architecture within a single biological species across its geographic distribution.
   - *Example 1*: The medicinal plant ***Rauvolfia vomitoria*** growing across different elevation gradients in the Himalayas exhibits genetic variation in the potency and concentration of its active antihypertensive chemical compound **Reserpine**.
   - *Example 2*: India harbors more than **$50,000\text{ genetically distinct strains of rice}$** and **$1,000\text{ varieties of mango}$**.
2. **Species Diversity**:
   - The variety, richness, and relative abundance of different biological species present within a defined geographic region.
   - *Example*: The **Western Ghats** have a significantly greater species richness of **Amphibians** than the Eastern Ghats.
3. **Ecological / Ecosystem Diversity**:
   - The diversity of ecosystems, biomes, and ecological niches present across a country or continent.
   - *Example*: **India** (with deserts, rainforests, mangroves, coral reefs, wetlands, alpine meadows) has far greater ecological diversity than a Scandinavian country like **Norway**.

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Currently ~1.7-1.8 million species are cataloged. Robert May estimated Earth's true richness at 7 million species. Animals comprise >70% (insects >70% of animals), and Fungi species exceed all vertebrate classes combined.

conceptBreakdown.content:
### 1.3 Global Estimates & Taxonomic Proportions
- Currently, the **IUCN (2004)** records slightly more than **$1.5\text{ million}$** described plant and animal species ($1.7\text{--}1.8\text{ million}$ cataloged).
- **Robert May’s Global Scientific Estimate**:
  - Ecologist **Robert May** applied rigorous statistical extrapolations of temperate-to-tropical insect diversity ratios, estimating the true global species richness at approximately **$7\text{ Million Species}$**.
  - This means **$>78\%$ of Earth’s biological species remain undiscovered and un-named**!

### 1.4 Global Taxonomic Proportions
- **Animals**: Account for **$>70\%$** of all recorded species.
- **Insects**: The most species-rich taxonomic group, accounting for **$>70\%$ of all animal species** (out of every 10 animals on Earth, 7 are insects!).
- **Plants**: Account for **$<22\%$** of total described species.
- **CRITICAL NEST EXAM INVARIANT**: The species richness of **FUNGI on Earth is GREATER than the combined total of all Fishes + Amphibians + Reptiles + Mammals**!

### 1.5 Indian Mega-Diversity Profile
- India occupies only **$2.4\%$** of the world's total land area.
- Yet it contributes an impressive **$8.1\%$** to global species diversity.
- Ranks among the **12 Mega-Diversity Countries** of the world, with $\approx 45,000\text{ plant species}$ and $>90,000\text{ animal species}$ documented.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Why Prokaryotic Diversity is Excluded from Estimates
conceptBreakdown.title: Why Prokaryotic Diversity is Excluded from Estimates
conceptBreakdown.content: Conventional taxonomic methods are unsuitable for identifying microbial species because most bacteria cannot be cultured in laboratory media, and biological species concepts based on reproductive isolation do not apply to asexual prokaryotes; modern metagenomic DNA sequencing suggests bacterial diversity could run into millions.
